    use b
    simp [h₀]
    <;> ring_nf
    <;> simp_all
    <;> linarith
  
  have h₂ : ∀ (y : ℝ), y ∈ Set.range f → c ≤ y := by
    intro y hy
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hy
    rw [h₀]
    have h₃ : a * (x - b) ^ 2 + c ≥ c := by
      have h₄ : a * (x - b) ^ 2 ≥ 0 := by
        nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x - b)]
      linarith
    exact h₃
  
  exact ⟨h₁, h₂⟩

  constructor

    rw [h₀]
    ring

    rw [h₀]
    dsimp

    have hprod : 0 ≤ a * (x - b) ^ 2 :=

    linarith
